claims.text: Anthropic's new agreement with the General Services Administration gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API.
claims.excerpt: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.

claims.text: The discount also extends to state, local, tribal and territorial governments.
claims.excerpt: The discount also extends to state, local, tribal and territorial governments.

claims.text: Anthropic says approximately 500 US federal, state and local government organizations now use Claude.

claims.text: Anthropic says weekly Claude for Government active users are up about eightfold since February, and usage across federal civilian agencies has grown about 20-fold in a year.

claims.text: Anthropic estimates the discounts will save the government $1 billion.

claims.text: Agencies are not bound by a minimum spend commitment and will pay for the usage they consume.

claims.text: In a four-week pilot, Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies, and 71% of them reported saving 20 or more hours.
